description: This file defines classes and methods for running load generator scenarios in an Orleans client environment, including configuration, connection setup, warming up, and execution of load tests.

classes.name: ClientParameters
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for the Orleans client, including service and cluster identifiers and URIs for Azure storage.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorParameters
classes.description: Holds parameters for load generation, such as the number of workers, blocks, requests, and duration.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorScenarioRunner
classes.description: Main class responsible for running a load generator scenario, managing cluster connection, warmup, and execution.

methods.name: LoadGeneratorScenarioRunner
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scenario runner with the specified scenario and logger factory.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Asynchronously runs the load test scenario with specified client and load parameters, handles cluster connection, warmup, execution, and reporting.
